Description:
Explore the fascinating world of geology with this 4-piece Rock & Mineral Specimen Box Bundle, ideal for hands-on learning and display. Each compartmented plastic box contains curated geological samples and features clear labeling for educational reference. This bundle includes one handwritten 'Rock Box', one handwritten 'Mineral Box', and two boxes labeled 'Minerals Collection One,' all neatly organized with identification charts listing stone or mineral names and properties. The specimens show varied colors, textures, and fragment sizes, offering authentic variety for study or collection. The translucent hinged cases reveal some surface wear, handwritten notes, and mild discoloration, all indicative of prior educational use. This set is perfect for students, teachers, homeschoolers, or enthusiasts seeking real mineral examples at an excellent value. These are not books or jewelry just genuine physical rock and mineral specimens in labeled storage cases, ready for your classroom or collection. All items are sold as shown; overall condition is used, with visible wear and markings.

Mineral Identification Collection Kit
Geological Specimen Study Set
8 Natural Mineral Samples in Display Box
8" x 6" x 2"
Numbered Collection
This professional mineral identification kit is an essential resource for geological education and scientific observation. The collection consists of eight distinct natural mineral specimens, including recognizable samples such as crystalline quartz, pink feldspar, and metallic pyrite. Each sample is individually numbered, allowing for systematic classification and study of physical properties such as luster, crystal habit, and cleavage.
Features 8 high-quality natural specimens housed in a 9-compartment white plastic organizer
Housed in a durable red textured storage case with a protective foam-lined interior lid
Provides a hands-on learning experience for students, hobbyists, and amateur geologists
